cohort: The study included 120 postpartum women who delivered at a hospital in Islamabad and had meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
finding: The incidence of puerperal pyrexia was significantly higher in women with Grade III meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) compared to Grade I and II MSAF.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher incidence of puerperal pyrexia (26.9%).
